mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.1% signals imminent monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% monthly, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns when S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of such cases, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.5%), labor market tightness increases wage pressures and corporate costs, compressing profit margins and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k) consistently boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without trigger conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline below 98.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 98.0, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation above 2.0% (CPIAUCSL > 2.0) and stable low rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals persistent inflation without policy response, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to real rate pressure.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market expansions (HOUST > 1050.0), increased residential construction activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1050.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
